meta.title: The Night Walk
meta.textType: time: the hours of the day

paragraphs: Today we go for a night walk. Mom, Tom, Pip, and I go. It is a long walk. At six o'clock, we have dinner. At seven o'clock, we put on our shoes. Then we go to the park. It is night. Pip walks next to Mom. We look at the lamps.

Mom has juice and grapes in her bag. At eight o'clock, we sit on a mat. "Let's sit here," says Mom. We eat the grapes. Tom drinks the juice. Pip looks at us. He likes grapes too. "What can you see at night?" asks Mom. "I can see a lamp," says Tom. "I can see a cat!" I say.
At nine o'clock, we go home. Pip is very happy. Tom is happy too. I go to bed. In the morning, I have school. Do you like a night walk? What do you eat at night? It is a good night!
text.summary: Lily tells us about a night walk with Mom, Tom, and Pip. They walk to the park at seven o'clock and eat grapes at eight o'clock.
